requirements.title: Sign in and sign out
requirements.acceptance: Valid active accounts obtain a role-scoped session; logout revokes the refresh token; tablet roles cannot enter the administration web.
requirements.negative: Wrong credentials, suspended users and expired/reused refresh tokens are rejected without retaining a usable web session.

requirements.title: Manage personal profile
requirements.acceptance: Display the current user profile. Profile editing and authenticated password change remain requirements, not accepted capabilities in this baseline.
requirements.negative: Do not present a mock success as a successful password change; the real auth adapter reports the operation unavailable.

requirements.title: Submit business application
requirements.acceptance: Submit required business and representative data; persist a PENDING application for administrative review.
requirements.negative: Reject malformed email, missing required fields and conflicting applications with actionable validation feedback.

requirements.title: Review registration applications
requirements.acceptance: List, search and inspect applications including representative information and review status.
requirements.negative: Unauthenticated and non-admin access must fail; an unknown application returns not found.

requirements.title: Approve and activate a business
requirements.acceptance: Approve a PENDING application atomically; create tenant and inactive Owner, a 14-day trial and a 24-hour password-setup link; activation follows password setup.
requirements.negative: Reject a reviewed application, duplicate representative identity or missing trial configuration; no partial tenant should remain after rollback.

requirements.title: Reject a business application
requirements.acceptance: Record rejection reason, reviewer and time; expose REJECTED status and the reason.
requirements.negative: Require a meaningful reason and reject attempts to review an already processed application.

requirements.title: Maintain service plans
requirements.acceptance: Create and update plan configuration, price, quotas and availability; use server values in client displays.
requirements.negative: Reject invalid amounts and quota values; do not silently remove a plan used by a subscription.

requirements.title: Manage business subscriptions
requirements.acceptance: Inspect tenant usage, renew or change plans and suspend access with recorded reasons.
requirements.negative: Reject an incompatible downgrade or unauthorized cross-tenant operation; preserve the subscription event history.

requirements.title: Manage branches
requirements.acceptance: Create and update branches within the authenticated owner chain and configured quota.
requirements.negative: Reject duplicate/conflicting data, quota overflow and access to another chain.

requirements.title: Maintain menu categories and items
requirements.acceptance: Maintain category, item name, image, shared price and enablement at chain level.
requirements.negative: Reject invalid prices and missing category/name; prevent cross-tenant mutation.

requirements.title: Configure item options
requirements.acceptance: Maintain size, sugar, ice and topping groups with extra prices, defaults and selection limits; attach groups to items.
requirements.negative: Reject invalid min/max selections, unavailable options and inconsistent defaults; backend calculates final price.

requirements.title: Assign menu to branches
requirements.acceptance: Assign chain items to selected branches; chain enablement and branch availability jointly determine sellability.
requirements.negative: A branch cannot sell an unassigned or chain-disabled item; changing assignment must not rewrite historical sale prices.

requirements.title: Manage branch managers
requirements.acceptance: Invite managers by email, assign/reassign branches, suspend accounts and resend setup links within chain scope.
requirements.negative: Reject duplicate email, invalid branch, quota overflow and unauthorized reassignment.

requirements.title: Link the merchant PayOS account
requirements.acceptance: Validate merchant credentials, store them encrypted and display only masked/link status data; unlink when permitted.
requirements.negative: Invalid credentials and missing encryption configuration must not yield a successful link; never return secret values.

requirements.title: Configure chain branding
requirements.acceptance: Configure supported logo, primary colour and display name; apply feature entitlement while retaining fixed semantic status colours.
requirements.negative: Reject invalid files/colours; a plan without branding must not apply custom branding to protected or public platform pages.

requirements.title: Read multi-branch business reports
requirements.acceptance: Select an authorized period and branches; display server-derived sales metrics and completed refunds with explicit period context.
requirements.negative: No cross-chain data; handle empty periods and decimal amounts without substituting mock values.

requirements.title: Ask business data questions
requirements.acceptance: Target requirement: answer read-only business-data questions within the owner chain, showing interpreted period and supporting values.
requirements.negative: Reject data modification and cross-tenant questions. Current web adapter is mock; no real AI completion is claimed.

requirements.title: Inspect plan and usage
requirements.acceptance: Display current subscription, expiry and usage. Current code additionally supports trial-to-paid PayOS checkout through separate platform credentials.
requirements.negative: A browser return URL alone must not activate a plan; expiry and downgrade limits remain enforced.

requirements.title: Maintain customer-display posters
requirements.acceptance: Create, update enabled state/order and delete chain posters; current API supports at most 10 posters, each at most 5 MB and duration 3-60 seconds.
requirements.negative: Reject invalid file/limit and cross-chain requests; replacement and ordering follow actual display-posters endpoints, not the old specification endpoints.

requirements.title: Prepare staff and counters
requirements.acceptance: Invite Cashier/Barista staff; configure counters and printers; pair/revoke displays using a scoped six-digit one-use code.
requirements.negative: Reject quota overflow, another branch, expired/reused pairing codes and revoked device tokens.

requirements.title: Set branch availability
requirements.acceptance: Toggle item and option availability for the assigned branch without changing chain prices or chain enablement.
requirements.negative: Do not enable a chain-disabled item; propagate availability changes and refresh conflicting state.

requirements.title: Read branch reports
requirements.acceptance: Show assigned-branch totals, trends and best sellers using date boundaries in Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh.
requirements.negative: Reject unauthorized branch filters; distinguish gross sales, completed refunds and net revenue.

requirements.title: Search and inspect orders
requirements.acceptance: Search COUNTER_PICKUP orders by supported filters; display authoritative item, payment, refund and event details.
requirements.negative: Do not reveal another branch order; preserve selected filters through navigation and handle unavailable records.

requirements.title: Resolve payment exceptions
requirements.acceptance: Review mismatch/late transfer evidence and confirm eligible payments with a reason; settle once and resume preparation.
requirements.negative: Reject insufficient amount, invalid state, duplicate settlement and cross-branch confirmation; refresh conflict responses.

requirements.title: Cancel paid orders and record refunds
requirements.acceptance: Cancel eligible undelivered whole orders or lines with reason; cap refunds at the remaining balance; record cash completed or bank refund pending.
requirements.negative: Reject delivered orders, over-refunds and ineligible partial cancellation; external bank transfer is not performed by this system.

requirements.title: Create a counter order
requirements.acceptance: Select station, sellable items and valid options; backend calculates total and stores price/option snapshots before finalization.
requirements.negative: Reject unavailable items, illegal options and edits after finalization; client-supplied price is not authoritative.

requirements.title: Receive cash and return change
requirements.acceptance: Accept sufficient cash; calculate change; settle atomically, allocate a daily branch calling number and queue paid items.
requirements.negative: Insufficient cash fails; repeated payment cannot allocate a second calling number or duplicate preparation units.

requirements.title: Receive PayOS payment
requirements.acceptance: Create a QR payment, verify the signed callback and correct amount, and settle once; permit supported status recheck and cash fallback.
requirements.negative: Expiry, mismatch and late transfer follow exception handling; never settle based solely on the browser/client claim.

requirements.title: Print receipt and calling ticket
requirements.acceptance: Read immutable sale data; produce receipt and calling ticket; record reprints with a reason; preparation must proceed if printing fails.
requirements.negative: Printer unavailable or render failure is reported with retry; physical Bluetooth printing needs device acceptance testing.

requirements.title: Read counter order history
requirements.acceptance: List permitted current-day counter orders and inspect receipt/reprint details in the assigned branch.
requirements.negative: Reject other-branch records and invalid identifiers; preserve original snapshot values.

requirements.title: Read the preparation queue
requirements.acceptance: Expose paid preparation units and compatible item grouping; do not release unpaid drafts.
requirements.negative: Concurrent batch claims cannot process the same unit twice; unavailable queue connection is visible.

requirements.title: Prepare and hand over orders
requirements.acceptance: Claim and complete items; when all active units are ready, update order and calling display; handover records delivery.
requirements.negative: Reject illegal transitions and stale claims; limited undo must respect the same actor and allowed time window.

requirements.title: Report sold-out items and options
requirements.acceptance: Record branch item/option sold-out status, notify clients and flag affected paid work for manager resolution.
requirements.negative: Do not mutate another branch or silently delete a paid order; existing shortages follow the exception workflow.
